input: Set up a donor-advised fund for charitable giving

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Donor-Advised Fund for Charitable Giving
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to establish a donor-advised fund (DAF) to organize and manage their charitable giving.

questions.title: Which sponsoring institution are you considering for the DAF?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference such as Fidelity Charitable, Schwab Charitable, Vanguard Charitable, or a community foundation.

questions.title: What initial contribution amount are you planning to make?
questions.description: Understand the opening funding amount the user intends to deposit into the DAF.

questions.title: What type of assets will you use to fund the account?
questions.description: Determine whether the user plans to contribute cash, appreciated stock, real estate, crypto, or other assets.

questions.title: What is your primary motivation for setting up a DAF now?
questions.description: Clarify whether the driver is a tax event, a large windfall, estate planning, or simply organizing giving.

questions.title: Do you have specific charities or causes already in mind?
questions.description: Understand whether the user has target recipients or is still deciding where grants will eventually go.

questions.title: Are you setting this up individually, jointly, or as a family legacy vehicle?
questions.description: Determine if the DAF is for a single person, a couple, or intended to involve future generations.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for opening the account?
questions.description: Find out if there is a deadline such as a tax year end, a financial event, or no specific urgency.
